City to City is an intercity coach service operated by Autopax, which has run City to City and Translux buses as a division of the state rail and bus operator PRASA since August 2024. It offers semi-luxury, no-frills coach travel between major South African cities and smaller towns, connecting Pretoria with destinations including Johannesburg, Durban, Cape Town and Polokwane, as well as cross-border routes into Mozambique, Zimbabwe and Lesotho.

Tickets can be booked through the company's own booking system or through retail partners and travel agencies, and the service maintains a dedicated Pretoria contact line for passengers needing route or booking help. From its Pretoria stop near Bosman Street, the service suits travellers looking for an affordable, scheduled alternative to flying or driving between provinces.

Clouds3c Cyber Security is a cybersecurity and digital forensics firm operating from the HB Forum Building in Val de Grace, Pretoria. Its specialists carry out digital investigations and extract court-ready digital evidence, alongside a full cybersecurity stack covering cyber assessments such as penetration testing and vulnerability scanning, cyber defence, perimeter security, incident response and governance work.

The firm works with organisations across the private and public sector, partnering with established security and infrastructure vendors including CrowdStrike, Microsoft, Fortinet and Veeam to tailor each solution to a client's environment, and places emphasis on educating clients so they can recognise and respond to threats rather than only reacting once an incident occurs. Based in Val de Grace, Pretoria, it serves organisations needing both proactive protection and forensic response after a breach.

Conic Consulting Engineers is a consulting engineering and project management firm marking 25 years in business, providing structural, road and traffic, urban and bulk services engineering, along with fibre-optic wayleave engineering for telecommunications rollouts. Its structural work spans residential, commercial and industrial buildings, while its road and traffic engineering covers access design, intersection upgrades and township-scale road networks for developers and municipalities.

The practice operates from multiple offices, including its Pretoria base in Silver Lakes, alongside branches in Hermanus, Bloemfontein and Polokwane, giving it reach across several provinces for both private development and public infrastructure projects. From its Tijger Valley offices in Pretoria, the firm serves clients needing engineering input on everything from individual site developments to municipal-scale infrastructure work.

Conor Solutions is a software and IT consulting company founded in 2007, made up mainly of senior IT professionals who deliver turnkey technology solutions to telecommunications, financial services, retail and government clients. Its work spans consulting and business analysis, solution architecture, carrier-grade software development built primarily on Java, Linux and open-source technology, mobile app development across all major platforms, and ongoing operational support and maintenance.

The company also builds search and Google Enterprise solutions, including Google Search Appliance and Google Maps integrations, and runs vehicle and personal tracking systems for clients needing asset visibility. Based in Southdowns Office Park in Centurion, it focuses much of its client base across Africa and South America, giving it a specialism in deploying enterprise technology into developing markets.

Cream Star Ice Cream is an ice cream manufacturer based in Hermanstad, Pretoria, producing and supplying a range that includes ice pops, milk pops, soft serve mix, flavoured syrups and yoghurt pops. The factory serves retail customers as well as wholesale buyers such as restaurants and caterers looking to stock their own freezers.

It works directly with trade customers who need consistent volumes of frozen treats rather than only walk-in retail sales, and fields regular enquiries about franchise and bulk supply opportunities. From its Slegtkamp Street premises in Hermanstad, it supplies customers across the wider Pretoria area, and is open Monday from 7:30am, Tuesday to Friday from 9am, and weekends from 10am to 2pm.

Crisp and Clean Clubview is a branch of the South African laundry and dry-cleaning franchise established in 2013, handling everyday wash-and-fold laundry, ironing and dry cleaning alongside more specialised work such as duvet and comforter cleaning, curtain cleaning, sneaker cleaning and carpet and upholstery care carried out on-site or at the customer's home.

The branch also runs a commercial laundry service for guest houses, restaurants, healthcare facilities, schools, sports teams, hotels, nail salons and gyms, offering a next-day turnaround on standard drop-offs. Operating from the corner of Lyttelton Road and Adam Tas Street in Clubview, Centurion, it suits households wanting reliable everyday laundry and businesses needing an outsourced commercial laundry partner.

CTM Montana is the Montana Park branch of CTM, South Africa's specialist tile and bathroomware retailer and part of the Italtile Group since the brand's launch in 1983. The store stocks tiles, sanitaryware, bathroom fittings and accessories, including CTM's own Tivoli, Kilimanjaro and Organic Earth ranges, and staff on the shop floor help customers work through product selection and pricing before a project gets under way.

The branch handles quotes and orders, with Click & Collect and delivery available for customers who would rather not transport tiles or sanitaryware themselves. Based on Taaifontein Street in Montana Park, Pretoria, it is open Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday from 7:30am to 5:30pm, Wednesdays from 8:30am to 5:30pm, Saturdays from 8am to 4pm and Sundays from 9am to 2pm, and it suits homeowners, renovators, DIY customers, builders and contractors working through bathroom, flooring or home-improvement projects of any size.

Daisy Business Solutions Pretoria is the Arcadia branch of Daisy, a national business technology provider that has operated since 1985 and now runs 56 branches across South Africa. Where this location was once positioned narrowly around copiers, PABX telephone systems and CCTV, Daisy has since grouped those products into wider national divisions: print and document solutions covering multifunction printers, wide-format printing and fleet management, and business security covering CCTV, access control, ANPR and thermal systems, alongside connectivity, telecoms, IT managed services, software, solar and energy, and business finance.

Clients can draw on one or several of these divisions rather than dealing with separate suppliers for printing, security and connectivity. Operating from Park Street in Arcadia, Pretoria, the branch serves businesses and organisations needing integrated technology, communications, printing or security infrastructure, from a single multifunction printer through to a full office security and connectivity fit-out.

Dalucon Insulated Panels is a family-owned manufacturer founded by Aldo Martinelli in 1991, with more than 50 years of combined experience across its team. It produces insulated panelling and roofing panels, insulated doors, cold and freezer rooms, clean rooms and telecommunication shelters, as well as insulated truck bodies and specialised mortuary equipment.

The company positions itself on quality and delivery reliability, manufacturing to a benchmark it says smaller competitors struggle to match, and offers factory tours for clients wanting to see the production process before ordering. Operating from Highway Business Park in Rooihuiskraal, Centurion, it supplies commercial and industrial clients needing custom insulated structures rather than off-the-shelf panels.

Dawie De Beer Attorneys is a Garsfontein-based law firm founded by a former magistrate who served on the bench for 17 years before being admitted as an attorney in 1999. The practice focuses on family and matrimonial law, insolvency matters, civil litigation, debt collection, and property-related and conveyancing work.

The firm takes a hands-on approach, with its founder dealing personally with each client's matter and drawing on a curated network of professionals built up over 25 years of practice. Based in Garsfontein, Pretoria, and open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, it suits clients who want direct access to an experienced attorney rather than being passed between junior staff.

Die Stasie is a padstal and function venue set in the Zwavelpoort valley along Atterbury Road, serving farm-style breakfasts made with free-range eggs, boerewors and roosterbrood alongside grilled beef mains and daily specials. Beyond its food offering, the venue hosts parties, baby showers, team-building days and live music evenings in its function spaces.

It markets itself as a gathering spot for everything from an early coffee to an evening of live music, with dedicated party booths and a large playground for children attending family functions. Located in Zwavelpoort, Pretoria, it is open from 7am daily, closing at 6:30pm Sunday to Tuesday, 7:30pm Wednesday and Thursday, and 10pm on Fridays and Saturdays.

Digital Parks Africa operates an Uptime Tier III Design Certified data centre in Samrand, Centurion, that was founded in 2017 as a 100% African-owned colocation and connectivity provider. Its Samrand facility is the company's flagship site, offering colocation space built for more than 4,500 racks, carrier-neutral network connectivity and up to 24 MW of utility power capacity for hyperscale and enterprise clients.

Alongside colocation, the company runs connectivity, real-time infrastructure monitoring and value-added remote-hands services, and also operates sites in Cape Town and Johannesburg, giving clients a choice of South African locations while keeping data sovereignty and compliance within the country. From Samrand, it serves businesses that need resilient, always-on infrastructure rather than running their own in-house server rooms.

Doornpoort Engineering (DPE) is an industrial engineering company operating from Hermanstad, Pretoria, offering turning and CNC turning, milling, drilling, and CNC gear, pulley and key manufacturing, alongside machine builds, maintenance, breakdown repairs, overhauls, fabrication and steel supply and preparation.

Its client base spans forklift companies, earthmoving contractors, agricultural and aviation businesses, plastic, food and textile manufacturers, pump manufacturers and the mining sector, reflecting a workshop built to handle varied, often urgent industrial repair work rather than a single product line. Based in Hermanstad's Slegtkamp Street industrial area, the business suits manufacturers and equipment operators needing a single workshop for custom fabrication and breakdown support alike.

Drips and Leaks Plumbers is a Meyerspark-based plumbing company handling maintenance, repairs and new installations for leaking faucets and pipes, and extends its callouts to pest control, air conditioning and electrical work for clients who would rather deal with one contractor than several.

The company uses SABS-approved products and accepts credit, debit and EFT payment, and operates around the clock so a burst pipe or electrical fault outside office hours doesn't have to wait until morning. Covering Pretoria East, North and West, Centurion, Midrand and the wider Gauteng area from its Meyerspark base, it is available 24 hours a day for emergency callouts.

Drivatic is a business systems and technology consulting firm, based at Spaces Menlyn Maine in Waterkloof Glen, that helps organisations replace disconnected spreadsheets and manual processes with connected business applications, data and automation. Its work covers building custom business apps, linking data across existing systems into a single data layer, management dashboards and Power BI analytics and reporting, workflow automation for alerts, approvals and reports, and practical AI implementation.

Rather than selling more software on top of an already patchwork setup, the firm starts with a free business diagnostic to identify where information is duplicated or disconnected before recommending a fix. Based in Pretoria, it works with businesses whose operations have outgrown the systems first set up to run them.

DSI, short for Dreamstate Interactive, is a Centurion-based software company offering custom systems development, website development and mobile app development alongside a line of its own proprietary products built for specific industries. Rather than building every client a one-off system from a blank page, it maintains these packaged products so clients in a regulated sector can start from something already built for their field.

Its in-house products cover sectors including health and safety compliance, legal services, auditing, construction, facility management and laboratory information management, giving the company a base of repeat, sector-specific software alongside its custom development work. Operating from Doringkloof, Centurion, it suits businesses that need either a bespoke application built from scratch or an existing packaged system for a regulated industry.

Dynatron Group is an Engineering, Procurement and Construction Management (EPCM) company operating across more than ten industries, delivering engineering consulting and design, procurement, maintenance, and construction and project management as turnkey packages rather than single-discipline contracts.

The group holds multiple Construction Industry Development Board gradings, including 9ME, 9EP, 9GB, 9CE, 8SI, 8SQ, 7SF and 6EB, reflecting the range of project types and values it is registered to take on, and it is led by a woman-led management team. Based at Riverside Office Park in Centurion, it serves public and private sector clients across South Africa and neighbouring countries needing electrical, mechanical and infrastructure project delivery.

E & S Engineering has served the national and international precast concrete industry since 1999 from its Rosslyn factory, manufacturing concrete moulds and shuttering, steel cutting and bending, and general light steel work using its own guillotine, bending machine, drills, punching machine, cut-off machines and three welding stations.

Its moulds have gone into major infrastructure work, including precast moulds, galvanised gates, manhole grids and overhang brackets supplied for an international airport project in Eswatini, and precast components for pipeline markers and pipe saddles used on the Durban-to-Gauteng oil pipeline, with further precast mould supply to manufacturers in Namibia, Botswana and Zambia. From its Hendrik van Eck Street premises in Rosslyn, the company serves large regional contractors and smaller precast manufacturers alike.

EB Staalwerke has manufactured steel products from Kameeldrift East, Pretoria since 1996, specialising in mild steel balustrades, carports, roofs and patios, security swing and slide gates, steel fencing, gate motors and intercoms, and customised burglar bars tailored to a specific window or doorway rather than sold as a standard size.

With more than 30 years in the trade, the business measures, plans and installs each project itself rather than subcontracting the installation, and has built a reputation across Pretoria, Centurion and Midrand for custom steelwork rather than standard off-the-shelf products. Based in Roodeplaat, it serves homeowners and businesses looking for both the manufacture and professional fitting of security steelwork, from a single gate to a full property's perimeter fencing.

EGP Solutions, trading as Energized Green Power Solutions, is a solar power installer based in Sinoville, Pretoria, with close to a decade of hands-on experience fitting photovoltaic systems for homes and businesses. Its technicians are certified on both DEYE and SOLAX equipment, covering the inverter and battery technology behind most of the solar systems it installs.

Beyond the initial installation, the business offers ongoing maintenance and support once a system is up and running, rather than treating the sale as a one-off transaction, which matters for solar setups that need periodic checks on inverters, batteries and panel connections to keep performing properly. Operating out of Sinoville, it serves Pretoria-area homeowners and businesses wanting a locally based installer they can call on again after the initial fit.

Electro Sol SA has traded since 1995, and has specialised in solar and backup power installations for residential, commercial and industrial clients from its Wingate Park base since 2014. It designs and installs photovoltaic systems ranging from standard rooftop arrays to larger solar-farm and portable power setups.

The company's longer trading history outside solar gives it grounding in general electrical backup and power work before it moved into renewable energy installations specifically. Based in Wingate Park, Pretoria, and open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, it suits households and businesses wanting an established, locally based installer rather than a newer market entrant.

Elior Konsultante is a family-owned Pretoria consulting firm, founded in 2015, that focuses on quality management systems and welding coordination, along with audit and training services supporting accreditation to standards including ISO 17020, ISO 17025, ISO 3834, PED and CPR. These are the standards that testing laboratories, inspection bodies and welding workshops are measured against, so the firm's work is aimed squarely at businesses operating in regulated technical fields.

The firm builds its service around close working relationships with a smaller base of clients rather than high-volume, one-off consulting engagements, working repeatedly with the same businesses on certification and compliance over time. Based in Lynnwood, Pretoria, it suits manufacturers, fabricators and testing or inspection bodies that need ongoing support getting through, and staying compliant with, technical accreditation audits.

Emirates Textiles has imported and supplied upmarket home textiles since 1999 from its showroom and office at Westhills Business Estate in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion. It wholesales fabrics including Egyptian cotton, percales, curtain linings, tabling, plain and printed sheeting, sateen, jacquards, bull denim, towelling and upholstery fabric.

Alongside raw fabric, the company supplies ready-made bed linen such as duvet covers, flat and fitted sheets, pillowcases, duvet inners, mattress protectors and toppers, towels and throws, serving both individual customers and the hospitality industry that needs bulk, consistent-quality linen. Operating from Sunderland Ridge, it suits retailers, hospitality buyers and individual customers sourcing home textiles at wholesale volumes.

EMT Butchery is a third-generation family business with roots going back to 1992, when it started out mainly selling offal before growing into a larger meat retailer, wholesaler and manufacturer. Its Eersterust branch sells fresh beef, pork, lamb, chicken, wors, offal and specialty cuts for both household and bulk buyers.

The business now runs four retail locations, in Eersterust, Waltloo, Soshanguve and Ga-Rankuwa, alongside its own meat-processing factory in Waltloo, Pretoria, which supplies all of its branches as well as wholesale customers. From Eersterust, it serves customers stocking a home freezer as well as restaurants and smaller butcheries buying in bulk.

ENJO Business Management Consultants (EBMC) was founded in 2014 to focus on skills development and training aimed at increasing the employability of the individuals it trains. It partners with ENJO Consultants for SAQA-accredited training courses, and also offers SDF consulting to help organisations improve their B-BBEE status, alongside an AI video creation service.

The company holds B-BBEE level 2 contributor status itself, and supports The Ladies of Hope as its corporate social investment project. Based in Die Hoewes, Centurion, it suits organisations needing accredited training delivered alongside practical B-BBEE compliance support rather than training and compliance advice from two separate suppliers.

Exclusive Landscapes is a Pretoria landscaping and garden design company that has worked on residential and corporate gardens for more than 16 years, designing in styles ranging from indigenous and water-wise gardens to Japanese, Tuscan and Bali-inspired layouts.

Beyond design and planting, the business handles paving, irrigation and tree care, taking projects from the initial site briefing through to final handover, and describes itself as one of the few longer-established landscaping firms still active in an industry where smaller outfits have struggled to keep up. Based in Akasia, Pretoria, and open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, it works across Pretoria, Pretoria East, Centurion, Midrand and Kempton Park.

Flash Fasteners is a retail supplier of industrial fasteners based in Pretoria North, stocking a wide range of nuts, bolts, threaded rod, washers, screws, pins, clips and brackets in materials including high-tensile steel, mild steel, stainless steel, electro-galvanised steel and brass.

Alongside fasteners, the store carries lifting nails, hinges, welding consumables and general hardware, and will place a special order for products not held in regular stock. Based opposite the Sasol Garage in Wolmer, Pretoria North, it suits tradespeople and DIY customers needing a specific fastener grade or size rather than only the common sizes carried by general hardware stores.

Friedland Hart Solomon & Nicolson is a Pretoria law firm formed in 2009 when the longstanding practices of Friedland Hart & Partners and Solomon Nicolson joined forces, bringing together roots that trace back more than a century. The merged firm runs specialist departments in corporate and commercial law, property law, and insurance law.

Its corporate team handles the revision of company documents, drafting and adoption of a new Memorandum of Incorporation, and advice under the Companies Act, while a separate estates department manages deceased and insolvent estates, trusts and Master's Office matters, and the firm also runs one of the larger general and correspondent litigation practices in Pretoria. Operating from Monument Park, it serves individuals, companies and estates needing specialist legal support across these areas.

G & M Ritechem manufactures industrial and domestic cleaning chemicals, sanitisers, degreasers and cleaning equipment from its Koedoespoort Industrial facility, formulating products using consistently sourced raw materials for both household and industrial-strength applications. Its range covers everyday categories such as brushware, mops and wax applicators, cloths and rags, kitchen and bathroom hygiene products and general janitorial supplies, alongside the chemicals themselves.

Field representatives work directly with client teams to assess cleaning needs and recommend the right products, and the company also provides free hands-on training so staff use the products correctly, aiming to cut waste and lower overall cleaning costs for customers. As the preferred local supplier for Pretoria, Centurion and Midrand, it offers free delivery across the region to wholesalers, retailers and direct clients.

G-Matrix Systems is an IoT engineering and electronic design company based in Zwartkop, Centurion, that designs, builds and deploys connected devices under its RAMAC product range. Its cable-theft sensors detect cuts in copper and fibre lines and push real-time alerts over Sigfox or LoRa networks without needing mains power at the pole, addressing a problem that costs telecom and rail operators heavily in losses from manual patrols that can't cover thousands of kilometres of remote line.

The company also builds temperature sensors for cold-chain logistics that stream readings into a monitoring portal with threshold alerts, and long-life, battery-powered vibration sensors for perimeter security that can run for years on a single battery. Based in Centurion Gate Business Park, it serves clients needing remote monitoring of infrastructure, cargo or perimeters rather than off-the-shelf consumer IoT devices.

Gauteng Motor Centre is a used-car dealership on Kgosi Mampuru Street in Pretoria Central that has traded for more than 30 years, selling pre-owned vehicles from brands including BMW, Volkswagen, Mercedes-Benz, Mini, Lexus, Land Rover and Audi.

The dealership arranges in-house financing for buyers rather than requiring customers to secure external vehicle finance before visiting, which can speed up a purchase for buyers who haven't already been approved elsewhere. Based in Pretoria Central, it is open Monday to Friday from 8:30am to 5pm and Saturdays from 8:30am to 1pm, and suits buyers looking for a long-established dealer in premium pre-owned brands.

GMK Group, whose name stands for God's Mighty King, is a Centurion-based group of companies spanning eight divisions from one head office: kitchen design, web services, engineering and construction, interior design, transport and travel, catering, real estate and a beauty parlour. It was registered in June 2015 as a Black Youth Owned business.

Each division operates under its own brand name while sharing the same head office, so a client can be connected to the right team through a single enquiry rather than approaching separate companies, and the group is also affiliated with independent partner businesses working alongside it. Based in Rua Vista, Centurion, it suits clients wanting more than one of these services handled by connected teams.

Grobbies Electrical is an electrical contracting business operating in the Gauteng region since 1992, carrying out electrical maintenance, motor and control-gear installation, distribution board work, and lighting and power system installations for both ongoing maintenance contracts and new installations across homes, offices and light industrial sites.

The company has added solar panel installation to its offering alongside its traditional electrical contracting work, giving existing maintenance clients a route into solar without switching to a separate installer for the backup power side of a project. Based in Silvertondale, Pretoria, it serves residential and commercial clients needing either routine electrical maintenance or a new electrical or solar installation.

GX Energy has operated in South Africa's power sector since 2006, supplying and installing generators, UPS systems, inverters, solar panels and batteries for residential, commercial and government clients.

The business is scaled to handle large commercial installations exceeding 2MW, putting it beyond simple residential solar fit-outs and into industrial-scale backup power and generation projects, and it backs its installations with country-wide support and a service level agreement rather than leaving clients to source their own maintenance once a system is installed. Based in Ashlea Gardens, Pretoria, it suits households wanting backup power and larger organisations needing substantial generation capacity alike.

HDCabling Centurion has traded since 2008 as a networking and audio-visual specialist, supplying and installing HDMI and home-cinema equipment alongside structured Ethernet and fibre cabling for homes and businesses.

Its store carries several thousand networking and AV products, from HDMI and DisplayPort cables and adapters to CCTV and Power-over-Ethernet switches, routers and wireless access points, home automation devices and professional audio and DJ cabling, giving walk-in and online customers the same catalogue. Operating across Centurion, Midrand and Pretoria East, it also installs DSTV, WiFi, network and CCTV systems for clients who want the cabling done rather than bought as a DIY kit.

HHL Irene is a branch of Handles, Hinges & Locks, an architectural ironmongery supplier that relocated its former Arcadia branch into a new showroom and warehouse in Irene in 2023. The company represents major ironmongery brands including Assa Abloy, Dormakaba, ISEO and Cisa, alongside its own in-house Status brand, and stocks grade 304 weather-resistant stainless steel ranges suitable for coastal or exposed applications.

Since relocating, the Irene branch has worked as a distribution hub between Pretoria and Johannesburg, supporting trade accounts, quoting on bills of quantity and tenders, and offering on-site after-sales service alongside its counter trade. Based in Pierre van Ryneveld Park, Centurion, it serves architects, contractors and developers needing door hardware specified and delivered at scale rather than bought item by item.

Hi-Fi Installations is a family-owned audio-visual and home-automation business that has operated since 1963, designing and installing TV mounting, home-theatre systems, bespoke cinema rooms, smart-home automation and custom audio setups for residential and corporate clients alike.

The business works with premium AV brands including Sonos, Yamaha, Denon, Marantz, KEF, Bluesound, NAD, Wharfedale and Bowers & Wilkins, giving it access to equipment at a level most general electricians don't stock, and it works alongside homeowners, interior designers and architects rather than only responding to a finished brief. Operating by appointment from Olympus, Pretoria, it suits clients planning a dedicated home cinema or whole-home automation setup rather than a single speaker or TV install.

INSA Coal Holdings is a coal investment and mining company based in Centurion, formed as a 50:50 joint venture between the Action Group of India and Incubex Minerals of South Africa. It holds a large portfolio of coal prospecting and mining rights across Gauteng and Mpumalanga, focused on projects in established coalfields that already have existing infrastructure and historical geological data, known in the industry as brownfield sites.

Its board and management team bring a combined total of more than 100 years of mining industry experience, and the company publishes a PAIA manual in line with its obligations under South Africa's information and privacy legislation. Based at Riverside Office Park in Centurion, it operates as a holding and development company for coal projects rather than running a retail or consumer-facing operation.

Just Water Pretoria is a bottled water manufacturer operating from a dedicated factory in Koedoespoort Industrial, where it produces its own plastic preforms and blows its own bottles on-site before filling them with still and sparkling water purified through reverse osmosis. Keeping bottle production and filling under one roof lets the factory control quality through every step rather than relying on bottles bought in from a separate supplier.

The facility supplies fast-food chains and the hospitality industry as well as other bulk buyers, and offers personalised labelling so customers can put their own branding on bottled water rather than using generic packaging. Based in Koedoespoort, Pretoria, it suits businesses needing a consistent, bulk supply of branded bottled water rather than buying off supermarket shelves.

JVD Commodities is an agri-trading company based in Die Wilgers, Pretoria, that sources and distributes raw materials for the animal feed industry, including oil cakes, grains, oil seeds, millers' by-products, full-fat soya, fish meal and fertilisers.

Beyond sourcing, the company supports feed producers and farmers with logistics coordination, cash flow management, risk management, stock control and administration, and publishes regular market reports to help farmers make informed buying and selling decisions. With more than 40 years of combined industry experience across its team, it serves feed producers and farmers needing a reliable raw-material supply chain rather than sourcing commodities directly from multiple separate traders.

KEAGEOZ Property Solutions is an estate agency established in 2005 and based in Eldo Meadows, Centurion. It is part of the wider Keageoz Group, which also includes bond origination, property development and interior design divisions, letting the agency draw on sister companies for financing and development advice during a sale.

The agency lists residential properties for sale and to let across Centurion and surrounding areas, and offers clients tools including property email alerts, bond calculators and area profiles to help with a purchase decision. Operating from Eldo Lakes Estate, it suits buyers and sellers who want an agency that can also arrange bond origination or interior design as part of the same transaction.

Kempston Logistics Pretoria is the Pretoria and cross-border division of the Kempston Group, a national transport operation that has run for more than 25 years. The division moves an average of around 50,000 loads, roughly 1.5 million tons of cargo, each year, with goods-in-transit insurance included on the freight it carries.

Operating from Hazeldean Office Park in Tyger Valley, the branch quotes directly on freight and cross-border transport requests rather than only operating as part of a larger national booking system, giving Pretoria-based clients a local point of contact for logistics. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, and suits businesses needing scheduled freight or cross-border transport rather than one-off courier jobs.

Kotara is a secure, 160-unit sectional-title residential complex in Willow Park Manor developed by TJ Investments, offering two- and three-bedroom apartments within a single gated estate rather than a mix of standalone houses and units.

Residents have access to a clubhouse, swimming pool and fitness trail, with 24-hour guarded security backed by CCTV monitoring and electric perimeter fencing around the property, offering a managed, lock-up-and-go alternative to a freestanding home that still needs its own gardening, pool upkeep and security arrangements. Located in Willow Park Manor in Pretoria's eastern suburbs, the complex suits buyers and tenants wanting apartment-style living with on-site security and shared recreational facilities rather than a standalone house requiring its own upkeep.

La Vida Beautyful is a slimming, health and beauty clinic in Meyerspark offering laser slimming treatments, slimming injections, faradic body sculpting and far-infrared sauna sessions alongside more conventional beauty services such as massages, facials, waxing, tinting and nail treatments.

The clinic also retails its own range of slimming and skincare products, including items from the Sontal and Lipogon ranges, for clients wanting to continue treatment at home between visits, and acts as an agent for Avon and Justine beauty products. Based in Meyerspark, Pretoria, and open Monday to Friday from 9am to 7pm, it suits clients combining a slimming programme with regular beauty treatments at a single clinic.

LC Viljoen Incorporated Attorneys was founded on 1 March 1989 and has grown into one of Centurion's established conveyancing practices, built on panel status with four of South Africa's largest banks: ABSA, FNB, Nedbank and Standard Bank.

Beyond conveyancing and bond registrations and cancellations, the firm handles property transfers, township establishment, sectional title development schemes, commercial developments, consolidations and subdivisions, rental agreements, wills and estates, and family law matters, drawing on a team with a combined total of more than 255 years of legal experience. Operating from Eldoraigne, Centurion, it serves individuals, property developers, estate agents, investors and bond originators needing direct instructions processed with banks.

Lebo Business Consulting is a 100% Black woman-owned consultancy founded in 2006, offering strategic business planning, operational efficiency assessments, market analysis and business transformation and change-management support to clients it describes as carefully chosen rather than taken on in bulk, deliberately keeping its client list small enough to give each one direct attention.

The consultancy is SETA accredited across several training areas and also works on executive search, contingency recruitment, permanent placements and flexible staffing solutions, pairing its strategy work with practical human resources and recruitment services such as advertising, response handling and shortlisting for open roles. Based in Annlin, Pretoria, it suits businesses wanting both strategic consulting and the recruitment or HR support to carry a change through.

Lefatshe Minerals and Consulting is a 100% Black-owned company, with 80% female and 20% male ownership, established in 2015 and focused on strategic water studies, geotechnical and geological services, environmental services, and civil design and construction.

Since its establishment, the company has completed water, minerals-exploration, geophysical survey and geotechnical projects both within South Africa and internationally, drawing on a multi-disciplinary team of professionals across its service areas, and works with selected partners on larger projects to deliver an end-to-end service. Based in Klerksoord, Akasia, it serves clients needing technical water, geological or environmental studies ahead of construction or mineral development.

Liebencharm Guest House is a Cape Dutch-style guest house set on a protea farm outside Cullinan, offering four en-suite rooms and two log cabins, each with its own private entrance, for guests wanting a self-contained stay rather than a shared-corridor hotel room.

The property includes a braai area for guests wanting to cook outdoors, and a separate honeymoon cottage for couples wanting more privacy than the standard rooms, with the farm setting giving guests space away from Pretoria's city centre without being far from it. Located on the Kleinfontein smallholding outside Cullinan, it suits couples, small groups and wedding or function guests needing nearby overnight accommodation.

Lloyd Viljoen Auditors traces its history back to 1965, when it was established as Lloyd, Steyn & Co, later passing through a period as Wiehahn Meyer Nel before taking its current name. The firm of Chartered Accountants and Registered Auditors provides auditing, independent reviews, financial reporting, payroll, income tax, financial consulting and public sector audit services.

Its client base is mainly small, owner-managed businesses and private individuals rather than large corporates, and the firm has expanded over the years to run four offices operating independently of one another. Based in Muckleneuk, Pretoria, it suits smaller businesses and individuals wanting a long-established local firm for compliance, tax and financial reporting work.

M2 Design and Manufacturing has operated from Silverton for 25 years, producing signage and branding work that spans graphic design, sign writing, billboards, flags and banners, corporate identity design and vehicle branding and wrapping.

The company also handles indoor and outdoor signage installation, turnkey shopfitting and branded promotional items, covering a project from initial design through to physical production and fitting rather than only supplying artwork for someone else to print. Based in Silverton, Pretoria, and open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, it serves businesses across South Africa needing vehicle branding or retail signage produced and installed by one supplier.
